preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 100,000.
Length of each permutation is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: for each test case, len(a_i) == n and all(1 <= a_i[j] <= n for j in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each permutation contains distinct integers from 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The number of subsequences k is positive and does not exceed f(n).

postconditions.expression: sum(l_i for i in range(k)) == n
postconditions.description: The total length of all subsequences equals the length of the permutation.
Each subsequence is either increasing or decreasing.

postconditions.expression: all(element in permutation for subseq in subsequences for element in subseq)
postconditions.description: Each element of the permutation appears exactly once in the subsequences.
